about: Case items for the after-grill page, judged yes or no on top of the confidence bar. Each quote comes from grill.md.

items.question: Does the page cover all seven requested changes (card grid columns, contact address, copyright year, the November 4 Event and intro title, the Overview Tag and its artwork, removing the start button, renaming the workflow Tag), each as its own decision or clearly named inside one?

Is every answer the grill settled (one column on phones and two below 1920px, the build-time year, Overview as a lead Tag rather than a Format, the stored ID renamed to agentic-workflow, the AXEL Event unchanged, Agentic workflow kept as a secondary Tag) shown as the agreed or recommended choice, and never contradicted?
Does the page keep the new Overview Tag apart from overview as the name of a listing page?

source.quote: The glossary will need to distinguish the new **Overview** Tag from an Overview listing page.

items.question: Does the page ask Han to confirm the three proposed test seams (content store and filters, rendered pages, visual inspection), naming what each one does not catch?
Does the card-grid item show the grid at a phone width, at 1512px and at 1920px, with one, two and three columns?

source.quote: Card grids use one column on phones, two up to 1919px, and three from 1920px.
